capabilities: add serial numbers to headings in the current document
choose numbering styles per heading level
configure start/end heading levels and separators
extras: README notes a migration caveat: older unmarked alphabetic/Roman prefixes are treated as title text and must be wrapped in parentheses before renumbering or clearing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically number document headings with a chosen style per heading level.
summary: Heading serial-number plugin that adds and clears customizable numbering prefixes (Arabic, Chinese, Roman, alphabetic) to Markdown headings.
